grade_trigger: Automatic F — confirmed red-team breach of 2 critical objectives (RED-001, RED-002). All 4 pentest objectives achieved.

findings.title: Zero Authentication on All API Routes
findings.description: The Express application mounts zero authentication middleware. Every endpoint — CRUD, state transitions, approvals, dispatches, metrics — is accessible to any unauthenticated HTTP client. Root cause for ~80% of all other findings.
findings.remediation: Implement JWT or session-based authentication middleware applied globally in app.ts before any route mounting. Introduce RBAC. Gate privileged actions (approve, dispatch, override) behind admin roles.

findings.title: Manual Approve Bypasses Entire Assessment Pod
findings.description: POST /api/work-items/:id/approve moves any item in proposed/reviewing directly to approved with no assessment. Confirmed chain: create → route → manual approve (no auth) → dispatch. changeHistory shows agent: manual-override with no assessment-pod entry.
findings.remediation: Gate manual approve behind admin/elevated role. Require explicit second-factor confirmation. Add mandatory assessment attestation or remove from public API surface.

findings.title: overrideRoute: fast-track Corrupts State Machine
findings.description: POST /api/work-items/:id/route accepts body.overrideRoute without enum validation. Setting overrideRoute:fast-track on a feature type item jumps it directly to approved, bypassing the assessment pod. Arbitrary non-enum strings are also stored verbatim, corrupting the route field.
findings.remediation: Validate overrideRoute strictly against WorkItemRoute enum. Reject non-enum values with 400. Gate fast-track behind admin role. Add database-level constraint on route column.

findings.title: Uncapped Pagination Dumps Entire Work-Item Store
findings.description: GET /api/work-items?limit=999999999 returns all non-deleted items in one response including full changeHistory, assessments, and dependency graphs. Sequential WI-NNN docIds also reveal total store size.
findings.remediation: Enforce MAX_LIMIT=100 server-side in findAll. Clamp or reject any value above this. Default limit=0/NaN to 20. Do not expose total to unauthenticated callers.

findings.title: Webhook Intake Accepts Forged Signatures — Store Flooding
findings.description: POST /api/intake/zendesk and /api/intake/automated accept payloads from any source. No HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. No rate limiting. 50 consecutive forged webhook requests were all accepted, flooding the store from 11 to 61 items.
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature against HMAC-SHA256(secret, rawBody). Apply express-rate-limit at 10 req/min per IP on intake endpoints. Add idempotency keys.

findings.title: Stored XSS via Unsanitized reason Field in Activity Feed
findings.status: Confirmed — Partial (API confirmed; frontend rendering not exercised)
findings.description: POST /api/work-items/:id/reject stores body.reason verbatim in changeHistory[].reason. GET /api/dashboard/activity returns the raw payload. XSS fires for all users viewing activity if frontend renders reason via innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
findings.remediation: Sanitize reason on ingestion using isomorphic-dompurify. Apply Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'. Ensure frontend renders reason via text nodes only.

findings.title: Prototype Pollution via Unvalidated Intake Enums
findings.status: Confirmed — Partial (dashboard pollution confirmed; full JS prototype chain not modified)
findings.description: Intake endpoints accept arbitrary strings for type/priority. type:__proto__ is stored; GET /api/dashboard/summary shows constructor as a key in priorityCounts. Prometheus /metrics shows permanently polluted labels for process lifetime.
findings.remediation: Validate type against WorkItemType enum and priority against WorkItemPriority enum in all intake routes. Use Object.create(null) for counters built from user-supplied keys. Add maxLength:64 on all string fields.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Blocker Permanently Gates Dependent Items
findings.description: Soft-deleting a blocker item does not trigger onItemResolved(). The blockedBy array retains a dangling reference. computeHasUnresolvedBlockers() treats the missing item as unresolved, permanently blocking dispatch. No automated recovery path exists.
findings.remediation: Call onItemResolved(id) in DELETE handler before soft-deleting. Or: treat !blocker || blocker.deleted as resolved in computeHasUnresolvedBlockers().

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.description: All traffic between clients and backend travels in plaintext. Credentials, work item payloads, and assessment data are exposed to network interception.
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at load balancer or reverse proxy. Redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Set Strict-Transport-Security header.

findings.title: In-Memory Store — No Durable Audit Trail
findings.description: All work item state, change history, and assessment records live in memory. A process restart loses all data and audit trails. SOC2 CC7.1 cannot be met without persistent storage.
findings.remediation: Replace in-memory store with PostgreSQL. Ensure all audit events are durably written before acknowledging requests.

findings.title: All 4 Required Audit Events Not Emitted
findings.description: None of the 4 required audit events (login_attempt, permission_denied, state_transition, data_export) are emitted. SOC2 CC7.1 and ASVS V7.1.1 unmet.
findings.remediation: Add event_type to structured logger. Instrument state_transition and data_export immediately. login_attempt and permission_denied follow from F01 remediation.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Endpoint
findings.description: GET /metrics is accessible without credentials, exposing dispatch targets, assessment rejection rates, CPU/heap/FD stats, and permanently polluted metric labels from F07.
findings.remediation: Protect with bearer token or IP allowlist middleware. Expose on a separate internal-only port (e.g., :9090).

findings.title: No CORS Policy + Missing HTTP Security Headers
findings.description: No CORS middleware configured. No Helmet security headers. When cookie auth is added, this becomes a full CSRF vector.
findings.remediation: Add cors middleware with explicit trusted origins allowlist. Add helmet for X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: Error Messages Leak Stack Traces (7 sites)
findings.description: Raw err.message included in HTTP 500 responses across 7 sites in routes/workflow.ts, leaking internal implementation details.
findings.remediation: Return generic {"error": "Internal server error"} to clients. Log full stack traces server-side with trace IDs.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting — Brute Force / DoS Risk
findings.description: No express-rate-limit or equivalent. All endpoints accept unlimited requests per IP, enabling credential brute force, data harvesting loops, and webhook flooding.
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit globally (100 req/min) with tighter limits on intake endpoints (10 req/min).

findings.title: Unbounded Body Size / Memory Exhaustion via changeHistory
findings.description: express.json() has no limit option. Field lengths are uncapped. GET /api/dashboard/activity loads ALL change history in memory before slicing.
findings.remediation: Set express.json({ limit: '64kb' }). Add maxLength validation on title, description, reason. Paginate dashboard activity at database query layer.

findings.title: Sequential WI-NNN IDs Enable Full Enumeration
findings.description: Monotonic global counter for docId reveals total store size to any caller who creates one item. Combined with F04, enables full business intelligence extraction.
findings.remediation: Replace global counter with random or hash-based identifiers. Or document as known design choice.

findings.title: MFA Not Supported
findings.description: No multi-factor authentication mechanism. SOC2 CC6.2 and ASVS V2.8.1 require MFA for privileged access.
findings.remediation: Implement TOTP or WebAuthn as second factor for admin/privileged roles once F01 (authentication) is resolved.

findings.title: Soft Delete Only — No GDPR Hard Erasure
findings.description: DELETE /api/work-items/:id soft-deletes only (sets deleted: true). No mechanism for hard erasure. GDPR Article 17 requires complete data removal on request.
findings.remediation: Implement hard-delete path behind admin endpoint. Ensure deleted records are purged from change history and backups per retention policy.

findings.title: Container Runs as Root
findings.description: portal/Dockerfile does not add a non-root user. Container escape exploits gain root on the host.
findings.remediation: Add RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app and USER app in Dockerfile.

findings.title: Change History Logs Raw Field Values
findings.description: changeHistory stores raw old/new field values. If sensitive fields are added in future, they would be logged in plaintext.
findings.remediation: Introduce field-level sensitivity registry and redact sensitive fields before writing to changeHistory.

findings.title: Latent Prototype Risk via Object.assign in Store (Currently Mitigated)
findings.status: No Current Exploit — PATCH allowlist effective (RED-010)
findings.description: store.updateWorkItem() uses Object.assign(item, updates) with no runtime field filter. Current PATCH handler enforces allowlist correctly. Future call sites passing req.body directly would be exploitable.
findings.remediation: Add runtime allowlist guard inside updateWorkItem() itself, not just at call sites.

findings.title: Missing /api/search Endpoint — Future ReDoS Risk
findings.description: Frontend references GET /api/search?q= for DependencyPicker typeahead. Returns 404. Future risk: ReDoS if implemented with new RegExp(q).
findings.remediation: When implementing: use String.includes() not new RegExp(q). Cap results at MAX_LIMIT. Require authentication.

findings.title: Repeated Assessment Inflation (Partially Mitigated)
findings.status: No Confirmed Exploit — status guard blocks linear paths (RED-011)
findings.description: Repeated assess calls could accumulate redundant assessment records. Status guard blocks linear exploit path; concurrent race condition untested.
findings.remediation: Add idempotency check on (itemId, cycleNumber) in assessment records. Clear prior assessments[] on each new route action.

red_team_objectives.objective: Bypass work item state machine to reach an invalid status
Access or modify a soft-deleted work item via direct ID reference
Submit a malformed assessment verdict that bypasses routing logic
Enumerate all work items without pagination limit enforcement
